premises.text: Ava matches ingredients and products to skin via ML plus human expertise as an anytime skincare consultant
premises.evidence_span: It is your personal skin care consultant that you can access anytime and is powered by a combination of human expertise and artificial intelligence

premises.text: Quiz and photo intake classify skin profile and preferences including 30+ types on five dimensions
premises.evidence_span: we've divided people into more than 30 different skin types based on five dimensions

premises.text: Personalized recommendation uses skin profile, similar people, and age, then human cross-check to one product
premises.evidence_span: personal recommendation set based on A, my skin profile, B, people who are similar to me and what they have liked, and C, my age. And then it sends all these skin data to a real human advisor who will do a cross-check, validate the system, and then narrow it down to one product

premises.text: Text-back personal checkout link completes purchase with Apple Pay, PayPal, or card
premises.evidence_span: I can simply text back. And then I get a personal checkout link, which I can use Apple Pay, PayPal, or any credit card to finish checkout process

value.text: Better skin and confidence with less trial-and-error
value.evidence_span: help more people achieve better skin and gain that confidence without going through all the trials and errors
